sky.qualification: Aegaeon's sky orientation for its camera; the shared universe draws the visible sky.
sky.sceneRegistrationChain: galactic -> ICRF (J2000 constants) -> body-fixed (IAU pole and prime meridian at the epoch) -> ecliptic presentation frame

provenance.source: JPL Saturn-system ephemeris. Frozen historical Aegaeon pole from the mission BPC at 2015-12-19T12:32:14.886 UTC, arbitrary display meridian; not a current spin prediction.
provenance.qualification: Computed Aegaeon Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.
